marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Wind southeast 15 knots diminishing to light early this evening
then increasing to northwest 20 early Thursday morning. Wind diminishing to
light Thursday afternoon. Showers beginning near noon changing to scattered flurries
Thursday morning. Fog patches forming early this evening and dissipating
Thursday morning. Temperatures plus 4 falling to minus 3 Thursday
afternoon. <br/>
